premise.claim: Dependabot: "Bumps scikit-learn from 1.4.0 to 1.5.0" in /samples/vineyard — the sample's pinned scikit-learn is a full minor version behind (1.4.0 predates the numpy-2-compat line of releases).
premise.reportedComponent: samples/vineyard/requirements.txt (sample pipeline images: python:3.10, hash-locked pip deps)
premise.evidence: base pins scikit-learn==1.4.0 (41 hashes) while 1.5.0 is published on PyPI and installable alongside every other pin — see results/hash-check-head.txt and results/sample-path-base-1.4.0.txt

findings.title: stale regeneration recipe in requirements.txt header (still says scikit-learn==1.4.0)
findings.evidence: results/header-recipe-base-1.4.0.txt PASS vs results/header-recipe-head.txt FAIL; same check, base vs head

findings.title: guard: the 1.5.0 hash pin is genuine, complete, and covers the Dockerfile platforms (cp310 manylinux x86_64 + aarch64)
findings.evidence: results/hash-check-head.txt: all 21 hashes match PyPI artifacts, full set equality, both linux platforms present; harness-bites proof in results/hash-check-mutated-bites.txt

findings.title: guard: the pinned set co-installs and the sample pipeline's sklearn/joblib/pandas code path behaves identically under 1.5.0
findings.evidence: results/sample-path-head-1.5.0.txt and results/sample-path-base-1.4.0.txt: identical MSE and identical train_test_split fingerprint (random_state=42) under both versions with the same numpy/scipy/pandas/joblib pins

liveNote: No live layer for this topic: the change only affects sample image contents. A docker build of samples/vineyard (make docker-build) on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 is the closest live check and needs a docker daemon.
